answer: Sponsor-staked admission blocks Sybil swarms. A newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes a 100 POA bond on that identity, locked six epochs and slashed if the newcomer proves fake. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 10,000 POA locked; an honest newcomer needs one bond. Each verified job sends a ripple through the sponsor's record, while one fraud sends a pulse of penalty across every identity that sponsor backed. A sable trail records who vouched for whom, so honest rewards are never diluted by fake crowds.
